comment: OBS-10 eval_chains cpu/io/irq baselines. Keyed by runner tag, same convention as tools/ci/bench_baseline.json: x86_64-local is the development machine and is reference-only evidence until the runner tags a baseline, x86_64-ci is the GitLab runner and records its own with --write-baseline. Never copy numbers between runners. tolerance_pct is deliberately wide because the chain latency is bimodal under synthetic load on a shared host; lower it per runner once the history is stable.
